name: customcat-mcp
description: CustomCat (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, create_order, get_order, track. Every tool maps

platform_mcp_customcat_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_CUSTOMCAT_API_KEY
platform_mcp_customcat_api_key.description: CustomCat API key (generated per 'API Custom Integrations' store; Settings in the app shows a read-only and a read-write key — create_order needs the read-write one), sent as the `api_key` parameter.

platform_mcp_customcat_sandbox.title: PLATFORM_MCP_CUSTOMCAT_SANDBOX
platform_mcp_customcat_sandbox.description: Set to 1 to send `sandbox: 1` with create_order and get_order (CustomCat's sandbox flag); left out when unset, so orders are real and charged.

tools.name: me
tools.description: CustomCat has no account endpoint; the probe lists the catalogue categories ([{category, category_url_slug, subcategories}]), so `account` is empty on success.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: GET /product: the products you set up in CustomCat ({products[{product{product_id, title, product_type, description, options, variants[{sku, title, price, cost, instock, option1, option2}]}}]}); `sku`/`price` are the first variant's. `query` and `category` are not accepted. The blank catalogue (GET /catalog) is not mapped.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: POST /order/{order_id} submits a real, charged order (unless the sandbox setting is 1) under a fresh UUID order id, which get_order and track take. `shipping_address` is {first_name, last_name, email, phone, address1, address2, city, state, zip, country (ISO-2)} (all but address2 required); `items` are [{sku, quantity}] for products made in CustomCat or [{catalog_sku, design_url, design_url_back, quantity}]; `shipping_option` is the shipping_method name from GET /shipping (required by CustomCat).

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: GET /order/status/{order_id} (your order id): {ORDER_ID, CUSTOMCAT_ORDER_ID, ORDER_STATUS (Pending, Verified, Shipped), ORDER_TOTAL, ORDER_DATE, SHIPMENTS[{TRACKING_ID, METHOD, VENDOR}], LINE_ITEMS[{STATUS, PRODUCT_NAME}]}. ORDER_DATE is a text date such as 'March, 27 2018 12:14:45'.

tools.name: track
tools.description: The SHIPMENTS[{TRACKING_ID, METHOD, VENDOR, NUMBER_ITEMS}] of GET /order/status/{order_id}; one event per shipment.
